description: List OneNote pages (Microsoft 365 notes). Pass a section_id to list pages in that section, or omit it to list recent pages across all notebooks (newest first). Optionally filter with a free-text search query. Returns each page's id, title, and created/last-modified times. Use to find a user's OneNote notes/pages before reading their content.

search.description: Optional free-text search query across OneNote pages (matches title and content).

section_id.description: Optional OneNote section ID (from list_sections). If omitted, returns recent pages across all notebooks.

top.description: Maximum number of pages to return (default 50, max 100).

name: list_pages
title: List Pages
